pages.text: Health 40, Armor 8, Toughness 4, Knockback Resistance 0.8, Attack 4.$(br)An independent version of Goety's skeleton servant: undead, ranged, and with all the gear and ownership behaviour intact.

It fights by shooting, switching to melee when a foe closes; follow, wander, stay and guard are cycled with Goety's commands, guard patrols around the chosen spot, and stay only stops its idle wandering - it still fights.

Give it a $(item)Raging Star$() and it becomes a $(l)Bone Scout$() for good: armour and toughness rise, it keeps constant damage reduction and regeneration, its arrows hit twice as hard and fly faster, white motes trail it,.

and its draws can empty into a machine-gun volley - which costs the bow no durability and ignores hurt frames on every arrow. It takes a few more slots in the Esoteric Tesseract, and the star flies back to its owner's pack when it dies.
